name: stem-unified-platform
description: Unified STEM Learning Platform integrating Explaino, MathNoteBook Scratchpad, VoiceAgent, and Science Kingdom Digital Lab

scripts.dev:stem: concurrently -n "NILO,MATH-BE,SCI-AI,EXO" -c "magenta,blue,cyan,green" "npm run dev:main" "npm run dev:math:backend" "npm run dev:science:ai" "npm run dev:voice"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "MAIN,SCRATCH-BE,SCRATCH-FE,VOICE,LAB" -c "magenta,blue,cyan,green,yellow" "npm run dev:main" "npm run dev:scratchpad:backend" "npm run dev:scratchpad:frontend" "npm run dev:voice" "npm run dev:lab"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:main && npm run build:voice
scripts.test:stem: npm run test:math:backend && npm run test:voice
